'''David Cox''' of Indio, California, was the random-draw winner of Puzzle 4 of the 1997 Dagobah Contest, from the remaining 1,039 correct entries.<ref name="sol4">[http://rothko.decipher.com/new/dagobahcontest/solution4.html The Dagobah Contest], Decipher (March 1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19970327214430/http://rothko.decipher.com/new/dagobahcontest/solution4.html Internet Archive]</ref>
